tools.name: mightycall_get_profile
tools.description: Return the MightyCall user that the connected API key belongs to: name, email, extension and role.

tools.name: mightycall_list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List the business phone numbers linked to the MightyCall account.

tools.name: mightycall_list_calls
tools.description: List calls in a time window (UTC). Default window is the last day. Filter by one call type or a search text.

tools.name: mightycall_get_call
tools.description: Return one call by its id, including the caller, the called parties and the call record.

tools.name: mightycall_list_voicemails
tools.description: List voicemails in a time window (UTC). Filter by read state or by a search text.

tools.name: mightycall_get_voicemail
tools.description: Return one voicemail by its id, including its caller, time, duration and record.

tools.name: mightycall_list_journal_requests
tools.description: List journal requests (the call and message log that drives the contact-center workflow). Filter by direction, outcome, workflow state, phone number or time window (UTC).

tools.name: mightycall_get_journal_request
tools.description: Return one journal request by its id, including its state, contacts and comment.

tools.name: mightycall_set_workflow_state
tools.description: Set the workflow state (Open or Resolved) of one or more journal requests. Changes live data in the account.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mightycall_get_profile, mightycall_list_journal_requests, mightycall_get_journal_request · Private data: mightycall_get_profile, mightycall_get_call, mightycall_get_voicemail, mightycall_list_journal_requests, mightycall_get_journal_request · Public sink: mightycall_get_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mightycall_get_profile, mightycall_list_journal_requests, mightycall_get_journal_request · Private data: mightycall_get_profile, mightycall_get_call, mightycall_get_voicemail, mightycall_list_journal_requests, mightycall_get_journal_request · Public sink: mightycall_get_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
